# talks frozen: no decisions, no growth (the referendum waits) until the thaw event totu_unity.40; a shorter freeze
# never cuts a longer one. Always freeze through these, never with set_global_flag.
TOTU_unity_freeze_60 = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = TOTU_unity_freeze_60_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { TOTU_unity_open = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { un_freeze_days = 60 }
			TOTU_unity_freeze = yes
			DDR = { country_event = { id = totu_unity.40 days = 60 } }
		}
	}
}
TOTU_unity_freeze_180 = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = TOTU_unity_freeze_180_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { TOTU_unity_open = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { un_freeze_days = 180 }
			TOTU_unity_freeze = yes
			DDR = { country_event = { id = totu_unity.40 days = 180 } }
		}
	}
}
TOTU_unity_freeze_365 = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = TOTU_unity_freeze_365_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { TOTU_unity_open = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { un_freeze_days = 365 }
			TOTU_unity_freeze = yes
			DDR = { country_event = { id = totu_unity.40 days = 365 } }
		}
	}
}
TOTU_unity_unfreeze = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = TOTU_unity_unfreeze_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		clr_global_flag = TOTU_unity_frozen
		set_variable = { global.TOTU_unity_thaw_day = 0 }
		TOTU_unity_update = yes
	}
}

# the German question is closed for good: two German states remain (the category and the window go, the
# drift stops, every wrapper does nothing). For a 'two German states' path, e.g. a PDS focus.
TOTU_unity_end_talks = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = TOTU_unity_end_talks_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { TOTU_unity_open = yes }
			set_global_flag = TOTU_unity_talks_ended
			clr_global_flag = TOTU_unity_frozen
			TOTU_unity_refresh = yes
		}
	}
}
